description: This source file defines the AppLifecycleLogger class responsible for logging application lifecycle events in a Windows app, including methods for different app states and resize events, utilizing Windows-specific diagnostics and logging channels.

classes.name: AppLifecycleLogger
classes.description: A singleton class that manages logging of app lifecycle events such as launch, resume, and resize, using Windows' logging infrastructure.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AppLifecycleLogger.

methods.name: GetTraceLoggingProviderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the trace logging provider is enabled.

methods.name: LaunchUIResponsive
methods.description: Logs the event when the UI becomes responsive after launch.

methods.name: LaunchVisibleComplete
methods.description: Logs the event when the app's launch is fully visible.

methods.name: ResumeUIResponsive
methods.description: Logs the event when the app resumes and UI is responsive.

methods.name: ResumeVisibleComplete
methods.description: Logs the event when the app's resume process completes and is fully visible.

methods.name: ResizeUIResponsive
methods.description: Logs a resize event indicating UI responsiveness with current view ID.

methods.name: ResizeVisibleComplete
methods.description: Logs a resize event indicating full visibility with current view ID.

methods.name: ResizeUIResponsive
methods.description: Overloaded method that logs resize event with specified view ID.

methods.name: ResizeVisibleComplete
methods.description: Overloaded method that logs resize complete event with specified view ID.

methods.name: LogAppLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Internal method to log a specific app lifecycle event with given fields.

methods.name: PopulateAppInfo
methods.description: Populates logging fields with app-specific information such as app ID, package name, and PSM key.
